blocks.title: Rectification
blocks.text: Rectification alternating current ko direct current mein badalne ka amal hai.

Diodes current ko aik simt (forward bias) mein guzarne dete lekin ulti simt (reverse bias) mein rokte hain. Rectification do qism ki hai, half-wave aur full-wave. Yeh un electronic aalaat mein use hoti hai jinhein mustahkam DC supply chahiye, jaise computers aur smartphones, kyunke zyada tar gharelu aur tijarati bijli AC hai. Forward bias par diode bara current guzarta, jab ke reverse bias diode se current amalan sifar hai; yahi khasiyat diode ko alternating current ko aik-rukhi (direct) current mein badalne deti hai.

Half-wave rectification mein AC signal aik aadha chakkar guzar kar aur doosra rok kar pulsating DC mein badalta hai. T period ka alternating voltage (transformer ke zariye) load resistance RL ke saath series mein diode D par lagaya jata hai (Fig 17.13). Musbat aadhe chakkar (0 se T/2) mein diode forward bias hai, bohat kam resistance deta, aur RL se current guzarta, jis se us par input ke mutabiq voltage banta hai. Manfi aadhe chakkar (T/2 se T) mein diode reverse bias hai, bohat zyada resistance deta, aur amalan koi current nahi guzarta, is liye RL par voltage taqreeban sifar hai. Yahi har chakkar dohraya jata hai. RL se current sirf aik simt mein behta hai, is liye direct current hai, lekin jhatkon (pulses) mein. Ghar mein backup ke liye use hone wale UPS mein rectifier aur battery charger battery ko chalate hain, aur inverter battery ke DC ko wapas AC banata hai (Fig 17.13 a, kitab mein block diagram).

blocks.alt: Teen panels. Input: voltage ki sine wave. Circuit: transformer ka secondary aik diode D ke zariye load resistor RL se jura. Output: sirf musbat aadhe chakkar nazar aate, darmiyan seedhe khala jahan diode rokta, yani pulsating DC.
blocks.caption: Half-wave rectifier (Fig 17.13 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Diode aik-rukhi valve ki tarah kaam karta hai: musbat aadhe chakkar guzarta aur manfi rokta hai, is liye har chakkar ka aadha zaya hota hai.

blocks.text: Full-wave rectification mein alternating input ke dono aadhe chakkar load se aik-rukhi current ban jate hain. Yeh bridge rectifier se hota hai, jis mein chaar diodes D1 se D4 band chakkar ya 'pul' (bridge) ki shakal mein jure hote hain (Fig 17.15 a). AC supply mukhalif konon ke aik jore (A aur B) se aur load doosre jore se jura hota hai; diodes series jore mein kaam karte hain, har aadhe chakkar mein sirf do current guzarte hain.

items: Musbat aadha chakkar (0 se T/2): terminal A, B ke muqable musbat hai. Diodes D1 aur D2 forward bias ho kar series mein current guzarte, jab ke D3 aur D4 reverse bias hain; current load se guzarta hai (Fig 17.15 b).

Manfi aadha chakkar (T/2 se T): terminal A manfi aur B musbat hai. Ab D3 aur D4 series mein current guzarte jab ke D1 aur D2 band hain. Load se current pehle wali simt hi mein behta hai (Fig 17.15 c).

blocks.text: Yun input ke dono aadhe chakkar load se aik-rukhi current bhejte hain. Output hamwar nahi balke pulsating hai; ise capacitors wale filter circuit se hamwar kiya ja sakta hai. Mobile phone chargers aam taur par deewar ke socket ke AC ko battery charge karne ke liye darkaar DC mein badalne ke liye full-wave bridge rectifier use karte hain (Fig 17.16; chhote bridge rectifiers do AC aur do DC siron wale aik package mein aate hain).

blocks.alt: Oopar: diamond ki shakal mein chaar diodes ke bridge ki do naqlein, konon A aur B ke aar-paar AC source aur baqi do konon ke aar-paar load. Musbat aadhe chakkar mein D1 aur D2 surkh (current guzarte); manfi mein D3 aur D4 surkh. Dono mein teer load se neeche current dikhata. Neeche: output, har aadhe chakkar ke liye aik musbat ubhar, half-wave output se muqable mein.
blocks.caption: Full-wave bridge rectifier (Figs 17.15 aur 17.16 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Supply ka jo sira bhi musbat ho, do diodes current ko aise mor dete hain ke woh hamesha load mein aik hi taraf se dakhil ho; koi aadha chakkar zaya nahi hota.

blocks.text: Smoothing capacitor ke saath full-wave bridge rectifier

Rectified output pulsating DC hai, jo zyada tar electronic aalaat ke liye munasib nahi. Smoothing filters AC hisse (ripple) kam karte hain. Capacitor filter mein capacitor load ke parallel jura hota hai: rectified voltage barhne par yeh charge hota aur voltage girne par load mein discharge ho kar output hamwar karta hai (Fig 17.17). Yeh smoothing (reservoir) capacitor zakhire ki tarah kaam kar ke aust DC output bhi barhata hai.

Smoothing capacitor wale full-wave bridge rectifier ka ripple voltage Vripple = IDC / (f_ripple C) = IDC / (2fC) hai, jahan IDC amperes mein load current, f input frequency aur C farads mein capacitance hai. Ripple frequency input frequency ki dugni hai: f_ripple = 2f. Yun zyada capacitance ya kam load current kam ripple deta hai.

blocks.title: Ripple C par munhasir hai
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai ke zyada se zyada ripple voltage 'smoothing capacitor ki qeemat se nahi balke frequency aur load current se tay hota hai', aur phir Vripple = IDC/(2fC) deti hai jis mein C hai. Formula durust hai: ripple capacitance par bhi aur frequency aur load current par bhi munhasir hai.

blocks.alt: Waqt ke muqable voltage ka graph. Dashed neele ubhar full-wave rectified pulses dikhate. Surkh lakeer har ubhar ke saath chotti tak uthti (capacitor charge) aur phir halki dhalwan se girti (capacitor load mein discharge) yahan tak ke agla ubhar use pakar le, daen taraf chhota ripple nishan zada. Neeche: Vripple = IDC/(fripple C) = IDC/(2fC); bara capacitor ya kam load current kam ripple.
blocks.caption: Capacitor se smoothing (Fig 17.17 ke mutabiq asal graph).
blocks.long_description: Chotiyon ke darmiyan capacitor load ko tawanai deta hai, is liye voltage sifar tak girne ke bajaye thora sa jhukta hai. Bara capacitor kam jhukta hai.

blocks.text: 50 Hz supply par full-wave bridge rectifier 2000 uF smoothing capacitor ke zariye 0.5 A load current deta hai. Ripple voltage maloom karein. Hal: Vripple = IDC/(2fC) = 0.5 A / (2 x 50 Hz x 2000 x 10^-6 F) = 0.5/0.2 = 2.5 V.

blocks.title: Dimagh ki kasrat
blocks.text: Cell phones AC jama karte hain ya DC? In ki batteries DC jama karti hain, jo AC se aasani se jama hota hai; grid AC deta hai, is liye phones, laptops aur torches charge karne se pehle rectifier se ise DC banaya jata hai. Kitab yeh bhi batati hai ke jism se guzarta AC dil ki dharkan bigar kar dil ka daura kar sakta hai; mains frequency ke currents khaas taur par khatarnak hain.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text: PN-junction diode rectification, signal clipping, regulation, voltage clamping, signal detection, photovoltaic cells aur roshni nikalne (LEDs) mein use hota hai.

blocks.prompt: Full-wave rectifier ko half-wave se hamwar karna aasan kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: Is ke pulses dugni dafa aate hain (ripple frequency 2f), is liye capacitor ko pulses ke darmiyan discharge hone ka aadha waqt milta hai aur usi capacitor ke saath ripple taqreeban aadha hota hai.

items: Rectification: diodes se AC ko DC (forward bias guzarta).
Half-wave: aik diode, aik aadha chakkar; full-wave bridge: chaar diodes, dono aadhe.
Load ke parallel smoothing capacitor; Vripple = IDC/(2fC).
